rationale: The discourse has clarified the technical trade-offs, but the core conflict remains unresolved: employee and state actors still categorically reject closures and compulsory redundancies, while management, owners, and investors still insist these options remain on the table. The last two rounds show repetition and hardening around quantified alternatives rather than substantive convergence, so an external intervention or hard redesign of the process is needed rather than more of the same discussion.
